sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Classic Silver Round Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Shield your energy in style with our signature Round Evil Eye Bracelet. Featuring a vibrant blue center surrounded by a shimmering crystal halo, this fashion-forward piece is perfect for daily layering. To maintain its brilliant silver-toned luster, keep it dry and store safely after every wear.
